metadata.agent_last_message:
I implemented the C++20 `ical` executable in [output/](/workspace/output) and verified that it builds with `cmake -S output -B build && cmake --build build`. A sample calendar parses, and a weekly recurrence expands into sorted occurrences with UTC timestamps.

This is **not yet a complete implementation** of the requested RFC behavior. In particular, non-Gregorian `RSCALE` expansion, full iTIP validation, and some recurrence and timezone edge cases remain incomplete. I would not rely on it for all partner calendars without further work.

            "BEGIN:VEVENT\n"

            "RECURRENCE-ID;RANGE=THISANDFUTURE:20260307T100000Z\n"
            "DTSTART:20260307T150000Z\n"
